verdict.rationale: Rive's own docs say the editor creates responsive layouts and builds experiences that respond to screen size, so the core responsive-layout capability is first-party. The evidence is only brief marketing-level mentions, with no detail on how layouts resize. missing for 10: documented auto layout behavior (direction, padding, gap, hug/fill), constraints or pinning, grid layouts, detailed layout docs, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, frames can behave responsively — auto layout, constraints, and grids resize designs the way real UIs flex

citations.quote: Create vector graphics, responsive layouts, and reusable components
Build interactive experiences that respond to user input, screen size, scrolling, and application state.
Connect animations, text, colors, layouts, and other properties to real-time data.
